sources.sizes: pkg/core/region_test.go TestRegionFromHeartbeatIAKVSize: KV=100 MiB, IA=40 MiB, clone preserves IA; absent IA=0. pkg/core/region.go RegionFromHeartbeat: approximate size bytes/1048576, positive sub-MiB clamped to 1, columnar truncation, uint64 keys cast to int64. Boundary cases are source-derived, not executed Go differential.
sources.membership: pkg/core/region.go RegionFromHeartbeat and classifyVoterAndLearner: preserve leader, roles, witness, sort down and pending peers by ID; factory.go RegionFactory/RegionPeerFactory preserve protobuf values. Unknown enum values remain raw wire integers.
sources.reports: RegionFromHeartbeat copies term, queryStats, interval, bucketMeta, replicationStatus and cpuStats; rejects read/write pairs independently at ImpossibleFlowSize=1<<50. TestRegionWriteRate asserts bytes=10 and keys=3 over interval=5 produce rates 2 and 0.6; GetLoads/GetWriteRate define query, unified-read CPU and interval calculation. Missing region/down-peer message is an adapter error instead of Go nil dereference. These expectations are source-derived.
